newsitem.title: USA: Amli gets $100 mln unsecured credit line.
newsitem.headline: Amli gets $100 mln unsecured credit line.

text.p: AMLI Residential Properties Trust said Monday it arranged a new $100 million unsecured revolving line of credit.
The facility will be used for acquisition and development activities and for general working capital purposes, the company said.

The new facility replaced two secured lines of credit with Wachovia Corp's Wachovia Bank and First Chicago NBD Corp's First National Bank of Chicago. The two banks led the group of lenders providing the new line of credit.
The credit facility carries an interest rate of LIBOR plus 135 basis points and has a term of three years with two one-year extensions.

"The new line of credit brings us closer to meeting AMLI's objective of an unsecured financing structure and toward our goal of achieving an investment grade rating," John Allen, AMLI's vice-chairman, said in a statement.
